name: Welcome A New Baby
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious gift and heritage from the Lord, formed and known intimately by God even in the womb, as He alone is the Creator who stretches out the heavens and fashions life (Psalms 127:3; Psalms 139:13; Isaiah 44:24). From infancy, God ordains strength through the mouths of babes to silence enemies, demonstrating their spiritual significance (Psalms 8:2). The responsibility to nurture and guide a child in the way of the Lord is emphasized, with the promise that such training will have lasting impact (Proverbs 22:6). Though the mysteries of life’s formation are beyond human understanding, they testify to the sovereign works of God who makes all things (Ecclesiastes 11:5).
